notes.title: Front Lines 3.1
notes.content:
Front Lines 3.1 Update
Content:
- A new navigation system has been added to Front Lines. The simulated fighter types will now be able to navigate themselves through far more complex paths than before. Your armies will mobilize with more thought in their paths. With the 3.0 Update behind us, fully enjoy the content of all the maps and paths possible in 3.1!
Artwork
- New artwork has been added to the Front Lines store page and Icon!
We have additionally just hit 20,000 downloads with continual growth!!!
- Thank you for all the support and comments. We are trying to improve the game constantly and we can't wait for what we have in mind for the future!!!

notes.title: Front Lines 3.0 Update
notes.content:
Horses, Possession, and a New main Menu Front Lines 3.0 Is Here!!!

3.0 has finally arrived with many changes both in formating and content! 
New Content
Horses
The new horsemen have been added to the game, allowing for a new kind of player to battle it out in Front Lines! The horse can run at speeds faster than any other player before.

Possession
View the battles in the first person with the Possession tool! The Possession tool finally will give you all the possibility to control your fighters in battle! The Possession tool currently works with all fighter types excluding horses and cannons. 

New Main Menu 
The main menu has been altered to give an enhanced opening experience to the player.

Two new Sandbox Maps
The Ice Island and the Wild West Island have been added to sandbox mode.

Additional Notes
Bug Fixes

notes.title: Front Lines 2.3 Update
notes.content:
Front Lines 2.3: Historical Battles Added!!!
Hello everybody. The Front Lines 2.3 Update has been released! Fight on the fronts of France and Persia! A new type of fighter has been added and new campaign missions are here! 

New Content: 

 Battle of Thermopylae added
 Battle of Waterloo added
 Musketman Added



Thanks for all the support Front Lines has gotten! We can't wait for all the new content that's still to come!

notes.title: 10,000 Users!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I am proud to announce that Front Lines has hit 10,000 users!
Thank you for all the support and bug fixes you have provided! We will continue to work with you to improve the game to its greatest potential!
Update 2.3 will be coming soon with further patch notes and content!
Thanks once again for all the support and have a great summer!

notes.title: Front Lines Mac Launch Glitch Fixed
notes.content:
Front Lines glitch hindering Mac users from starting the game has been patched!
Thank you all for your comments, bug reports, and suggestions! We look forward for the next update!
